status: PROPOSAL, UNWIRED. The owner approved reference spec v1d for development only (OD-NG-6, 2026-10-22); the owner's 1W ruling (2026-10-23) is DEV-only and grants no F3 access. 1M and the extended horizon stay UNAVAILABLE; the 24-bar contract extension is deferred, not cancelled. Any use is PROPOSED-REQUIRES-OWNER-APPROVAL.
formula: p_timeout = (n0 * pi0 + T) / (n0 + K); p_up = p_down = (1 - p_timeout) / 2, computed once; K == 0 returns pi0 exactly
label_rule: r = close[j + horizon_bars] / close[j] - 1; UP if r > band, DOWN if r < -band, else TIMEOUT
population: 1D anchors have reference_close (UTC epoch seconds) a multiple of lattice_bars * bar_seconds; 1W anchors use the 2026-09-21T00:00:00Z phase and extend backward only
counting_rule: K and T count every matured anchor (single day type) with horizon_end <= reference_close and reference_close >= the deployment start when one is given; when memory_days is not null, also require horizon_end > reference_close - memory_days; T counts TIMEOUT labels
n0_rule: v1's pseudo-count, n0 = 3 days of lattice rows, computed exactly: 3 * 86400 / (lattice_bars * bar_seconds) = 1 row for 1D and 0.14285714285714285 row for 1W (v1's integer formula, written for intraday bars, gives 0 for both)
prior: a single pi0 supplied by the caller from a frozen corpus; never computed here
pending: The 24-bar extension stays deferred, not cancelled
provenance: NGA plan v1.0 §F.2 L1 ('spec v1d (1D 365 d single type; 1W all available)'); v2 §F.2 L1; Track A §7 ('single type for 1D+', 'pseudo-count n0 = 3 days of rows'); owner's ruling 2026-10-23 defines 1W Monday 00:00 UTC alignment and 2026-09-21T00:00:00Z backward lattice phase; memory from plan v1.0 §F.2 L1; n0 from v1's rule
